title: Solve for a stationary distribution
description: You enforce the stationary equations and check one transition update.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You form P.T minus the identity matrix. This encodes the stationary equation for a probability vector unchanged by transitions.

steps.question: What does replacing the last equation enforce?
steps.answer: The row of ones with final right-hand value one requires the entries of pi to sum to one.

steps.description: You solve the system by least squares, clip entries into [0,1], and normalize the result. Exceptions are reported through _err and raised again.
You print pi_star and its product with P. Both recorded vectors are approximately equal, showing the distribution stays unchanged under that update.
